claim_mappings.rationale: DOCS-VAR-SMALL-001: Variables are short reusable text strings.

DOCS-VAR-SMALL-209: The README introduces data-tag access to the example variable values.
DOCS-VAR-SMALL-006: The example accesses the scalar using the foo.bar.meaning_of_life data tag. DOCS-VAR-SMALL-007: The example accesses the nested value using the foo.bar.nested.values.too data tag.
